verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a comprehensive REST Checkout/Management/Platforms API surface, with idempotency, webhooks, credentialing, an OpenAPI spec repo as source-of-truth, llms.txt/markdown docs for AI consumption, and a dedicated MCP server exposing common operations. This directly satisfies AI-native, agentic driving of the product via documented public APIs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of the OpenAPI/MCP tooling actually working end-to-end (only vendor docs/probes, no third-party review of API usability for AI agents).
